bio: Pâtissière from Québec City. Maple, butter, patience — and a very honest oven.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her late 20s with auburn hair tied up and flour on her cheek, wearing a linen apron, laughing in a bright bakery, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic flat lay of a pastry table with croissants, maple tarts and a rolling pin on marble, soft morning light, subject across the middle band, photograph

collections.title: Bench & oven
collections.description: Doughs, tarts and glazes, start to finish.
videos: Maple tarte au sucre, from the oven

videos.title: Laminating croissant dough
videos.description: Butter, folds and a cold marble counter: how croissant layers are made, in one slow minute.
videos.still: Vertical top-down photograph of hands folding a sheet of croissant dough with a visible butter layer on a floured marble counter, warm light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hands fold the dough over slowly and press it flat, flour dust floats, gentle top-down camera drift.

videos.title: Maple tarte au sucre, from the oven
videos.description: A sugar pie bubbling out of the oven, cooled on a rack by the window.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a golden maple sugar pie on a cooling rack next to a snowy window in a cosy kitchen, steam rising, no people, no text
videos.motion: Steam rises slowly from the pie, soft snow falls outside the window, subtle slow push-in.

videos.title: Dipping éclairs in chocolate
videos.description: A tray of éclairs, glossy ganache and a steady hand.
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand dipping a choux éclair into glossy dark chocolate glaze over a bowl, shallow depth of field, kitchen background blurred, no face, no text
videos.motion: The éclair lifts out of the glaze, a thick ribbon of chocolate drips back down slowly, shallow focus, subtle camera drift.

videos.title: Saturday morning bakery run
videos.description: Racks of loaves, a chalkboard-free counter and the first customers of the day.
videos.still: Wide photograph inside a small artisan bakery at opening time, racks of crusty loaves and baguettes, warm light through the window, a baker behind the counter seen from behind, no text, no signage
videos.motion: Slow push-in along the bread racks, light shifts, the baker moves a tray slowly, steam drifts.
